soybean.name: Soybean
soybean.climate_requirements: Growth responds to air temperature, day length, and water availability. Germination depends on soil temperature.
soybean.water_requirements: The reference gives 450 to 800 mm per cycle for maximum yield. Water needs vary with management, climate, and cycle length.
restrictions: Water availability is particularly important during establishment, flowering, and grain filling.
rotation_roles: Grain legume for diversified cropping systems

corn.name: Corn
corn.climate_requirements: Temperature, water, and solar radiation influence development. Germination depends on soil temperature, and flowering responds to air temperature.
corn.water_requirements: Water availability is critical during tasseling, flowering, and grain filling.
restrictions: Check the cultivar group and planting system in the applicable ordinance.
rotation_roles: Grass crop for sequences with legumes
reference_titles: Embrapa Corn and Sorghum — How climate affects corn

sorghum.name: Grain sorghum
sorghum.climate_requirements: A warm-season crop sensitive to low nighttime temperatures.
sorghum.water_requirements: Water is important during the seedling and flowering stages, even in crops tolerant of dry spells.
restrictions: For a second crop, limited water late in the growing cycle can constrain cultivation.
reference_titles: Embrapa Corn and Sorghum — Sorghum questions and answers

oat.name: White oat
oat.climate_requirements: A cool-season annual grass. Planting dates depend on the intended use and region.
restrictions: Confirm the species and intended use before applying an official planting window.
The ZARC oat category covers more than one species. Check the cultivar in the ordinance.
reference_titles: Embrapa — Green manure and cover crops in Brazil
MAPA — Current ZARC ordinances for São Paulo

sunn_hemp.name: Sunn hemp
sunn_hemp.climate_requirements: A warm-season species grown for cover and green manure. Establishment depends on the planting date and local conditions.
restrictions: The references apply to Crotalaria juncea.
reference_titles: Embrapa — Green manure and cover crops in Brazil

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane
purposes: Other uses as specified by the planting category
sugarcane.climate_requirements: Heat and solar radiation promote growth when water is available. Cooler temperatures and lower water availability can favor ripening.
sugarcane.water_requirements: Water availability is especially important during establishment and vegetative growth. Demand depends on growth stage, soil, and local growing conditions.
restrictions: The ordinances consulted cover rainfed cultivation. Check the intended use, soil available water class, and 10-day planting period for the municipality in ZARC.
rotation_roles: Stalk production with the potential for regrowth after harvest
reference_titles: MAPA — Current ZARC ordinances for São Paulo
